verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents creating CKS clusters via the Cloud Console, Terraform, or API, with node pools of any size on bare-metal GPU nodes and InfiniBand networking. Spot and on-demand capacity are described as pay-as-you-go with no long-term commitments, and Capacity Finder handles placement. However, larger node counts are gated by quotas that require an increase request, and nothing shows self-serve account signup, so 'without a sales cycle' is only partly established. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve onboarding without sales contact, confirmation that InfiniBand fabric applies to spot/on-demand multi-node pools, quota-free or self-serve quota scaling, independent hands-on corroboration.
